notes.title: История с неопределенным финалом: Don't Nod погружается в финансовый кризис
notes.content: Французская Don't Nod все глубже погружается в финансовый кризис. Причиной стал провал последних игр студии, включая Jusant и Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden, которые были хорошо приняты игроками и критиками, но не смогли привлечь достаточно покупателей, отбить затраты и заработать денег.

notes.title: Нарративный директор DON'T NOD Стефан Боверже покидает студию, игроки переживают за будущее разработчиков Life is Strange
notes.content: Нарративный директор DON'T NOD Стефан Боверже внезапно объявил об уходе из студии. Он был ведущим сценаристом Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden, Vampyr и Tell Me Why, а также приложил руку к созданию Remember Me и Life is Strange.

notes.title: Jusant и Banishers признаны финансово провальными — DON'T NOD отложила разработку двух новых игр
notes.content: Дела DON'T NOD, ответственной за Jusant и Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden, обстоят не лучшим образом. В своем последнем финансовом отчете французская компания подтвердила, что продажи обеих игр не достигли ожидаемых уровней.

notes.title: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden's Patch 1.4 is now live!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Banishers 🕯️[/h2]

[i]Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden[/i]'s patch is live! It brings updates, bug fixes and optimizations, make sure to read the list of changes below.

[b][h3]Combat and Enemies [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the behavior of certain enemies and bosses that could make combat much easier in rare configurations. 
[*] Fixed cases where enemies could not reach the player or remained invisible. 
[*] Addressed a bug where the "Unable to change equipment" warning was displayed incorrectly, and adjustments to ensure that UI indications accurately reflect the current state of potions and skills. 
[/list]
[b][h3]Progression et Quests  [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Solved issues blocking progression in certain missions, corrected missing quest markers, and adjustments to ensure the correct triggering of story events. 
[/list]
[b][h3]Environment and Navigation [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues where the main character could fall through the ground or get stuck in the environment, notably at the entrance to Fort Jericho's barracks and on certain isolated rocks.  
[*] Corrected certain navigation interactions that were difficult to access or could block the player if interacted with from a specific angle (rope, jump, narrow path). 
[*] Removed several invisible collisions that could block player movement. 
[*] Adjusted navigation zones to prevent movement anomalies like falling animations of the hero. 
[*] Resolved issues with invisible collision preventing the destruction of a soul grabber or a creeping ivy node. 
[/list]
[b][h3]Cinematics and Dialogues [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues affecting the playback of cinematics and the consistency of dialogues: facial animation problems, overlapping voice-overs, adjustment of the audio volume of certain dialogues or music, camera adjustments hidden by a decor element. 
[/list]
[b][h3]Visuals [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues related to the display of certain textures, missing or persisting visual effects, and improved the visual integration of environmental settings (rocks, vegetation, snow, etc.). 
[*] Addressed an animation issue where NPCs like Danniel Keayne and Antea would become invisible under certain conditions. 
[/list]
[b][h3]Photomode [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed various bugs related to photo mode (display of interaction input, HUD elements remaining visible, etc.). 
[*] Addressed issues with camera control in photo mode between AZERTY and QWERTY setups. 
[*] Fixed a white filter appearing on screenshots in photo mode on Steam. 
[/list]
[b][h3]Interfaces and Menus[/h3][/b] 
[list]
[*] Corrected button overlays and visual adjustments to improve readability and interaction. 
[*] Fixed interface issues, such as skill texts not updating correctly. 
[/list]
[b][h3]Audio [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the frequency of dynamic dialogues to reduce the excessive repetition of certain lines (e.g: Antea calling for a switch) 
[*] Resolved issues where music would abruptly cut off in various situations, such as approaching the graveyard at the start of the game, in combat, during certain cinematics, and when using the PS5's share feature. 
[/list]
[b][h3]Stability and Performance [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed various crashes and freezes on PC and consoles. 
[*] Improved overall stability across different platforms, especially concerning framerate drops in dense areas, when moving from one region to another, or during certain player actions. 
[*] Addressed issues causing delays in opening the in-game menu after long sessions, particularly on PS5. 
[/list]
[b][h3]Achievements [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that could prevent the completion of the "Full Potency" achievement. 
[/list]
[b][h3]AI[/h3][/b] 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain NPC routines did not occur as expected, leading to incorrect visual interactions. 
[/list]
[b][h3]Localization and Translations [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected various subtitle and voice-over problems, including gender errors, typos, and narrative inconsistencies in several languages. 
[/list]
[b][h3]Control Options [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue affecting key reconfiguration. 
[/list]

notes.title: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden review
notes.content: Banishers imagines a world where the restless dead are a common occurrence, be they wisps, giant monsters or chatty ghosts bearing unfinished business. Much as you’d call a plumber to fix a leaky pipe, here you send for a Banisher to remove a troublesome spirit, either by hacking it to bits or peacefully ascending it to another plane of existence. They’re basically Witchers, but without the genetic experiments that leave them emotionally bereft... Read more.

notes.title: Watch the Banishers Gameplay Breakdown Trailer to learn 5 tips before playing!
notes.content:
[b][h2]🌙 Dear Banishers,[/h2][/b]
We're glad to unveil our new Gameplay Breakdown trailer for Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden! 
Discover all the core features of the game before playing it. 

[previewyoutube=onVB92Tl4As;full][/previewyoutube]

Take on the roles of two skilled ghost hunters and partners facing challenging decisions with profound consequences for both the living and the dead.

[h3]Unleash the full force of the Banishers[/h3]

New Eden, 1695: Antea and Red are lovers and Banishers, trained spirit-hunters, protecting people from lingering specters. In a world full of occult danger, play as both characters, face difficult choices and make hard decisions while fighting all kinds of nightmarish creatures, combining Red’s weaponry with Antea’s spectral abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315294/76e394851b351c285cf65866a52d52d653412ad7.jpg[/img]

In this new trailer, you’ll navigate the lands of New Eden, learning more about your purpose as Banishers and how to help lift the curse affecting its people - while dealing with your own tragedy as lovers: one living, one dead. Discover a mix of combat styles with Red’s rifle, sword, and firebane alongside Antea’s ethereal attacks. 

With her otherworldly skills, unveil the unseen and unleash devastating spiritual attacks, from teleportation to spectral damage zones. Switch characters effortlessly to create combos and powerful synergies as you face increasingly malicious foes.

Every soul you banish, every spirit you grant peace, every life you sacrifice to save Antea will inexorably guide you towards one ending or another. Will you be a merciful savior or a relentless banisher?

This new trailer will bring the deeply enthralling and poignant story to life, providing a glimpse into the intricate lore of [i]Banishers[/i] and the key relationship between Antea Duarte and Red mac Raith.

notes.title: Focus Entertainment and DON’T NOD unveil Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden
notes.content:
Following the success of Vampyr, Focus Entertainment and DON’T NOD had announced a new collaboration to bring one of the most ambitious projects in the history of both the publisher and the studio. Focus Entertainment’s participation in [b]The Game Awards 2022[/b] is the occasion to unveil this brand new project, set to release in late 2023: [b]Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden[/b]. 

Experience [b]a powerful and intimate narrative in this Action-RPG[/b], playing as two proficient ghost hunters and lovers, faced with impossible choices and their dramatic consequences for the living… and the dead. The[b] World Premiere Reveal Trailer[/b] showcases the hallmarks of DON’T NOD: a striking art direction, strong characters and plot, as well as a unique fantasy world.

[previewyoutube=y4nHiS9O5PM;full]https://youtu.be/y4nHiS9O5PM

[/previewyoutube]“[i]We’re so excited to finally lift the veil on Banishers, a project born from our long-standing partnership with DON’T NOD[/i]” says John Bert, Managing Director at Focus Entertainment, “[i]The studio has an unmatched talent for creating worlds that are as unique as they are immersive. They are amazing storytellers who know how to truly enhance an efficient, innovative gameplay with narrative and emotions. That’s exactly what they are doing with Banishers. It’s a very ambitious project, which is sure to receive a very warm welcome from players all around the world[/i]”.

"[i]I am very proud of the talented team hard at work developing this exciting new action-RPG and delighted to once again have the privileged support of our accomplished partner Focus Entertainment.[/i]” shares Oskar Guilbert, CEO of DON'T NOD, “[i]We are very excited to be at The Game Awards for this announcement and hope that this first teaser gives players a glimpse of the deep and intense experience that Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden will offer. We look forward to revealing more in the coming months![/i]"

[h3]About Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden[/h3]
New Eden, 1695. [b]Antea Duarte and Red mac Raith are lovers and Banishers, ghost-hunters who vowed to protect the living from the threat of lingering ghosts and specters[/b]. Following a disastrous last mission, Antea is fatally wounded, becoming one of the spirits she loathes. In the haunted wilds of North America, the couple desperately searches for a way to liberate Antea from her new plight.

Immerse yourself in [b]a beautiful, intimate and powerful story between two fated lovers[/b]. As Banishers, enter the lives of New Eden’s communities and [b]solve haunting cases in a mystical, lore-rich world plagued with supernatural creatures and ancient secrets[/b]. Use your wits or combine Antea’s spiritual powers and Red’s arsenal to defeat and banish the souls tormenting the living.

[b]Challenging decisions[/b] will lay on your path, [b]dramatically impacting your story[/b] and the fate of New Eden’s inhabitants—be they living people or wandering souls. How much will you compromise your ghost-hunting vow for the sake of your lover who became one of such spirits?

[b]Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden will be released end of 2023[/b] on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC.
